Sensor_Alarm.label: Sensor Alarm
Sensor_Alarm.description: The autosen Sensor Alarm object can be used to set alarm conditions for sampled sensor data. If condition is true, an action could be triggered e.g. upload immediately

Sensor_Value_Path.label: Sensor Value Path
Sensor_Value_Path.description:
Resources are specified using Core Link syntax
Example:
Instance #0: </3303/0/5700>
Instance #1: </3303/1/5700>

Alarm_Condition.label: Alarm Condition
Alarm_Condition.description:
0: disabled
1: Upper Bound is exceeded 
2: Lower Bound is exceeded
3: In between bounds
4: Outside of bounds

Lower_Bound.label: Lower Bound
Lower_Bound.description: Lower bound of the sensor value(s)

Upper_Bound.label: Upper Bound
Upper_Bound.description: Upper bound of the sensor value(s)
